w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: It's settled. The village is calling it "Old Gavel." The Codex keeps it.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Buffering mauled Carlos (-76 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — staying out of sight for the rest of the day — too hurt to meet it again

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Peyton. Ad Break, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
💪 Your Strength grows — 7. The work is changing you.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/11/6), with 4 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE WITNESS — "Offer them a way back."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Lucas Brown ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
